intro.text: Uncommon spren that appear around creative work such as painting or drawing. They are about finger-length, glow silver, and take the shape of things they have recently seen.

description.text: They move those shapes in odd ways, such as a table rolling like a wheel, and seem to crumble like sand when touched.
The more skilled the artist, the more likely they are to appear.
Singers bond a creationspren to take artform.
They can also take the shape of things the person imagines.

items.text: Once bonded as armor, they can convey feelings and impressions to their Radiant.
They change shape freely, often resembling Shadesmar's beads, and can model a form for ordinary beads to follow.
